description: Create (idempotently) an auto-renewable subscription inside a group, with USA price and an optional free trial. Sets territory availability automatically. Pro feature.

family_sharable.description: Allow Family Sharing of this subscription (default false).

free_trial.description: Free-trial length. Omit for no trial.

group_level.description: Rank within the group (1 = top tier; default 1). Higher-value plans get a lower number.

group_reference_name.description: Subscription group reference name (created if absent)

review_note.description: Notes for App Review: how to reach the paywall, test instructions

name: create_subscription
title: Create a subscription
